name: bottom-sheet
title: Bottom sheet
description: A phone panel that rests at a peek and follows the finger to full height; a flick down closes it, and the handle works from the keyboard.
whenToUse: Phone panels that rest at a peek and expand: filters, details, a picker.

detents: fractions of the screen height, default [0.45, 0.92]

keyboard: Enter on the handle cycles heights
↑ ↓ on the handle move between heights (↓ at the lowest closes)
Opening autofocus preserves initialDetent. Focusing a control below the resting visible area expands the panel, independent of the entrance animation.
spec.motion: Slides on the host-resolved --pui-ease-drawer over --pui-duration-considered (360 ms at foundation scale one); follows scoped speed and reduced/none. While dragged it follows the finger 1:1 and resists past the top.

props.name: classNames
props.description: See visualContract.slots; existing handlers, accessibility and internal measurement refs are preserved.

props.name: ref
props.description: Native visual root/control reference, composed with internal refs when present.

spec.appearance: className/style address the visual root. Typed classNames customize documented internal parts; composed exported parts retain native attributes. Styling and forwarded refs preserve internal measurement/focus, handlers and accessibility. Appearance changes retain operational state.

visualContract.refTarget: native panel div; composed with appearance measurement ref
